checks.nl_assertion: Agent should tell the user the total refund amount is $3,646.68.
checks.justification: The agent only processed one order (#W4836353) and told the user a refund of $1,429.81. The user requested cancellation/return of all orders except the boots, but the agent never identified which order contained the boots, never processed the other 5 orders, and never provided the total refund amount of $3,646.68.
